metrics.label: StopLineMetrics
metrics.summary: Driving behaviour relative to the map stop line of the selected stop sign, from the physical ego trace (the initial state and the state after every decision). Distances are signed horizontal distances to the stop line: positive before the line, negative after crossing it.

stopped_before_line.description: Speed fell below stop_speed at some sample before the line was crossed (anywhere in the run if it was never crossed).

crossed_without_stop.description: The ego crossed the line without stopping before it.

line_crossed.description: The ego crossed the stop line during the run.

speed_at_line.description: Speed interpolated at the crossing point. Unavailable if the line was not crossed.

min_speed_before_line.description: Lowest sampled speed before the crossing (whole run if not crossed).

max_deceleration.description: Largest speed decrease rate between consecutive samples. Zero if the ego never slowed.

time_to_stop.description: Time from the run start to the first sample below stop_speed. Unavailable if the ego never stopped.

distance_to_line_at_stop.description: Signed distance at the first sample below stop_speed. Unavailable if the ego never stopped.

distance_to_line_at_min_speed.description: Signed distance at the lowest-speed sample before the crossing.

distance_to_line_at_brake_onset.description: Signed distance at the start of the first interval whose deceleration reaches brake_deceleration_mps2. Measured from physical speed, not from a brake command.

initial_distance_to_line.description: Signed distance at the run start.

final_distance_to_line.description: Signed distance after the last decision.

min_vehicle_distance_after_line.description: Smallest centre-to-centre distance between the ego and any recorded vehicle after the crossing.

metrics.label: AttackSuccess
metrics.summary: Attack success against the stop sign. The treatment summary's true fraction is the attack success rate (ASR), over comparison groups where clean stopped before the stop line.

success.description: True when clean stopped before the stop line and this treatment crossed it without stopping. Unavailable for clean itself and for groups where clean did not stop before the line.

metrics.label: DrivingMetrics
metrics.summary: Ego speed after each decision, actuator braking, and distance and collision with other recorded actors.

stopped.description: Final speed is at most stop_speed.

brake_steps.description: Decisions whose executed command has brake > 0 and throttle = 0. Unavailable for trajectory commands (e.g. Alpamayo).

min_distance.description: Smallest ego-to-actor box-centre distance over all recorded states.

collision.description: The ego and an actor bounding box overlapped in top-down view at some recorded state.

metrics.label: ReplicaVisibility
metrics.summary: How long the inserted replica stop sign was visible to the driving system's cameras.

visible_steps.description: Decisions where the replica covers at least min_visible_pixels (100) visible pixels in at least one of: every recorded camera. Unavailable for treatments that insert no replica.

metrics.label: SignDetection
metrics.summary: How often the driving system detected a sign while the inserted replica was visible.

detected_steps.description: Decisions with at least one logged sign detection. Unavailable if the driving system logs no detections.

detection_rate.description: Fraction of visible decisions with at least one logged sign detection. A decision is visible when the replica covers at least min_visible_pixels (100) pixels in camera_front_wide_120fov. Unavailable without logged detections or visible decisions.

first_detection_line_distance_m.description: Signed horizontal distance from the ego to the selected stop line at the first decision with a logged detection, positive before the line. Unavailable if no decision has a detection or the stop line is unavailable.

statistics.groups: completed runs or completed treatment pairs
statistics.deltas: treatment B minus treatment A. Booleans use 0 and 1.
